dedupe_keys.name: a benchmark dataset for vision based bridge traffic load monitoring in a cable stayed bridge

description: A Benchmark Dataset for Vision-based Bridge Traffic Load Monitoring in a Cable-stayed Bridge is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors LIANGFU GE, Danhui Dan (Tongji University, Western University). Traffic load monitoring based on deep learning and computer vision is studied in bridge engineering worldwide. Unlike traditional traffic load monitoring systems, computer vision-based techniques can accurately extract the spatiotemporal load distribution across the entire bridge in an autonomous manner. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
